scenarios.name: other-artifact-creatures-get-plus-one-plus-one
scenarios.why: The static anthem gives OTHER artifact creatures +1/+1; the tapped-and-dying artifact creature and any artifact creature benefit, and the Chief does not pump itself.

scenarios.name: nonartifact-creatures-unaffected
scenarios.why: Only artifact creatures get the bonus; a nonartifact creature keeps its printed toughness.
